lead_raw_text:
The structure of Cr₃O₄ (Cr₆O₈ per unit cell) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I4/mmm (No. 38), with 14 atoms spanning three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Cr centers in octahedral coordination by six O neighbors, with Cr–O distances of 1.89–2.01 Å, while O centers have three Cr neighbors. Corner-sharing between Cr octahedra is observed, and the geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component.
